findings.title: The required V2 evidence-schema change is simultaneously forbidden by the specification

summary: REQUEST_CHANGES. The r2 scope now includes approval.py, the evidence schema, and relevant fixture/test surfaces; the specification also now requires artifact identity, a shared loader-backed consumer, and a bounded single-use action-approved production collection. Those changes resolve RF-001 through RF-003 in REV-0001-r0004. A new blocking contradiction remains: scope item 4 requires changing the V2 evidence schema to add evidence_ref and mutation_evidence_sha256, while non-goal 2 expressly forbids changing the evidence schema. The task must remove or narrow that prohibition, then re-freeze the specification and regenerate current classification/review context before implementation.
